paragraphs: Vornado is a fully‑integrated REIT and conducts its business through, and substantially all of its interests in properties are held by, the Operating Partnership, a Delaware limited partnership. Accordingly, Vornado's cash flow and ability to pay dividends to its shareholders are dependent upon the cash flow of the Operating Partnership and the ability of its direct and indirect subsidiaries to first satisfy their obligations to creditors. Vornado is the sole general partner of and owned approximately 91.3% of the common limited partnership interest in the Operating Partnership as of December 31, 2025.
•51 Manhattan operating properties consisting of: •19.2 million square feet of office space in 26 of the properties;
•2.3 million square feet of street retail space in 45 of the properties; •1,331 units in two Manhattan residential properties;
•Multiple development sites and redevelopment projects, including 350 Park Avenue, Sunset Pier 94 Studios, 623 Fifth Avenue, the Hotel Pennsylvania site (PENN 15) and other PENN district sites;

•A 32.4% interest in Alexander's, Inc. ("Alexander's") (NYSE: ALX), which owns five properties in the greater New York metropolitan area, including 731 Lexington Avenue, the 1.1 million square foot Bloomberg, L.P. headquarters building, and The Alexander, a 312-unit apartment tower in Queens;
•Signage throughout the PENN District and Times Square; and
•Building Maintenance Services LLC ("BMS"), a wholly owned subsidiary, which provides cleaning and security services for our buildings and third parties.
•The 3.7 million square foot THE MART in Chicago;
•A 70% controlling interest in 555 California Street, a three-building office complex in San Francisco's financial district aggregating 1.8 million square feet; and
•Other real estate and investments. OBJECTIVES AND STRATEGY
Our business objective is to maximize Vornado shareholder value. We intend to achieve this objective by continuing to pursue our investment philosophy and to execute our operating strategies through:
•maintaining a superior team of operating and investment professionals and an entrepreneurial spirit;
•investing in properties in select markets, such as New York City, where we believe there is a high likelihood of capital appreciation;
•acquiring quality properties at a discount to replacement cost and where there is a significant potential for higher rents;

headings: We may be adversely affected by trends in office real estate.
A significant portion of our properties is located in the New York metropolitan area and is affected by the economic cycles and risks inherent to this area.
We are subject to risks that affect the general and New York City retail environments.
Our performance and the value of an investment in us are subject to risks associated with our real estate assets and with the real estate industry.
Real estate is a competitive business and that competition may adversely impact us.
We may be unable to renew leases, lease vacant space or relet space as leases expire on favorable terms.
Bankruptcy or insolvency of tenants may decrease our revenues, net income and available cash.
Some of our potential losses may not be covered by insurance.
Actual or threatened terrorist attacks or other criminal acts may adversely affect the value of our properties and our ability to generate cash flow.
The effects of climate change could have a concentrated impact on the areas where we operate and could adversely impact our results.
Our properties are subject to transitional risks related to climate-related policy change.
Changes to tax laws could affect REITs generally, the trading of our shares and our results of operations, both positively and negatively, in ways that are difficult to anticipate.
Significant inflation and increases in the inflation rate could adversely affect our business and financial results.
We face risks associated with property acquisitions.
We are exposed to risks associated with property development, redevelopment and repositioning that could adversely affect us, including our financial condition and results of operations.
It may be difficult to sell real estate on a timely basis, which may limit our flexibility.
We are subject to risks involved in real estate activity through joint ventures.
We are exposed to risks related to our properties that are subject to ground leases arrangements which could adversely affect our results of operations.
Capital markets and economic conditions can materially affect our liquidity, financial condition and results of operations as well as the value of an investment in our debt and equity securities.
We have outstanding debt, and the amount of debt and its cost may increase; refinancing may not be available on acceptable terms and could affect our future operations.
We may not be able to obtain capital to make investments.
The hedge instruments we may use to manage our exposure to interest rate volatility involve risks.
Covenants in our debt instruments could adversely affect our financial condition and our acquisitions and development activities.
A downgrade in our credit ratings could materially and adversely affect our business and financial condition.
Vornado's Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust (the "declaration of trust") sets limits on the ownership of its shares.
The Maryland General Corporation Law (the "MGCL") contains provisions that may reduce the likelihood of certain takeover transactions.
Vornado may issue additional shares in a manner that could adversely affect the likelihood of certain takeover transactions.
We may change our policies without obtaining the approval of our equity holders.

Steven Roth and Interstate Properties may exercise substantial influence over us. They and some of Vornado's other trustees and officers have interests or positions in other entities that may compete with us.
There may be conflicts of interest between Alexander's and us.
The trading price of Vornado's common shares has been volatile and may continue to fluctuate.
Vornado has many shares available for future sale, which could hurt the market price of its shares and the redemption price of the Operating Partnership's units.
Loss of our key personnel could harm our operations and adversely affect the value of our common shares and Operating Partnership Class A units.
Vornado may fail to qualify or remain qualified as a REIT and may be required to pay federal income taxes at corporate rates, which could adversely impact the value of our common shares.
paragraphs: Material factors that may adversely affect our business, operations and financial condition are summarized below. We refer to the equity and debt securities of both Vornado and the Operating Partnership as our "securities" and the investors who own shares of Vornado or units of the Operating Partnership, or both, as our "equity holders." The risks and uncertainties described herein may not be the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe to be immaterial may also adversely affect our business, operations and financial condition. See "Forward-Looking Statements" contained herein on page 6.
RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESS AND OPERATIONS

In 2025, approximately 78% of our net operating income ("NOI" a non-GAAP measure) is from our office properties. Work from home, flexible or hybrid work schedules, open workplaces, videoconferencing, and teleconferencing have become more common in recent years. Changes in tenant space utilization, including from the continuation of work from home and flexible work arrangement policies, may continue to cause office tenants to reassess their long-term physical space needs, which could have an adverse effect on our business. Additionally, the increased use of artificial intelligence ("AI") could result in changes in tenant space utilization, including the need to reduce or reconfigure space.

Further, as office tenants reevaluate their physical space needs and focus on attracting and retaining talent, many tenants have become more selective and are focused on leasing space in high-quality, modern and well-amenitized buildings near transit hubs. These factors have resulted in increased competition among landlords to attract tenants, significant landlord capital expenditures for a building to maintain Class A status and may negatively impact the value of older and less desirable office space. This could have an adverse effect on our financial condition and results of operations.

In 2025, approximately 88% of our NOI is from properties located in the New York metropolitan area. We may continue to concentrate a significant portion of our future acquisitions, development and redevelopment in this area. Real estate markets are affected by economic downturns and we cannot predict how economic conditions will impact this market in either the short or long term. Declines in the economy and declines in the New York metropolitan area real estate market have impacted and could continue to impact our financial performance and the value of our properties. In addition to the factors affecting national economic conditions generally, the factors affecting economic conditions in this area include:
• financial performance and productivity of the media, advertising, professional services, financial, technology, retail, insurance and real estate industries;

Funds from operations ("FFO") attributable to common shareholders plus assumed conversions for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $486,826,000, or $2.42 per diluted share, compared to $470,021,000, or $2.37 per diluted share, for the year ended December 31, 2024. paragraphs: Vornado 是一家完全整合的 REIT，其業務透過，且 substantially all of its interests in properties 都由，德拉瓦州有限合夥企業（Delaware limited partnership）-operating partnership 進行。因此，Vornado 的現金流及支付股東紅利的能力，取決於 operating partnership 的現金流，以及其直接與間接子公司首先償還債權人義務的能力。Vornado 是 operating partnership 的唯一普通合夥人，並持有約 91.3% 的普通有限合夥權益，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日。
•51 麻省街地產營運中，包含：•19.2 百萬平方英呎辦公空間於 26 間地產中；
•2.3 百萬平方英呎街道零售空間於 45 間地產中；•兩間紐約曼哈頓住宅地產共 1,331 單位；
•多個開發地點與重建項目，包括 350 Park Avenue、Sunset Pier 94 Studios、623 Fifth Avenue、Hotel Pennsylvania 站點（PENN 15）及其他 PENN 區域站點；
•於 Alexander's, Inc. ("Alexander's") (NYSE: ALX) 持有 32.4% 股權，該公司擁有五處位於紐約都會區的不動產，包括 731 Lexington Avenue、1.1 百萬平方英呎 Bloomberg, L.P. 董事會大樓，以及位於皇后區的 312 單位公寓大樓 The Alexander；
•PENN 區域與時代廣場的標誌；以及
•Building Maintenance Services LLC（"BMS"），一家全資子公司，為我們的建築物及第三方提供清潔與安全服務。
•370 萬平方英呎的 THE MART 在芝加哥；
•持有位於舊金山財務區的555 California Street三棟辦公大樓複合體70%的控制權益，總面積約180萬平方英呎；以及
•其他不動產及投資。 OBJECTIVES AND STRATEGY
本公司業務目標為最大化Vornado股東價值。我們意圖透過持續遵循投資哲學並執行營運策略來達成此目標，具體方式為：
•維持優秀的營運與投資專業團隊及創業精神；
•在如紐約市等特定市場投資不動產，我們認為這些市場有較高的資本增值可能性；
•以低於重置成本的價格收購品質良好的不動產，且這些不動產有顯著的租金上漲潛力；

paragraphs: 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務結果摘要
2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，本公司歸屬於普通股股東的淨收入為 842,851,000 美元，即每股稀釋後普通股 4.20 美元，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度歸屬於普通股股東的淨收入 8,275,000 美元，即每股稀釋後普通股 0.04 美元相比。

2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，本公司歸屬於普通股股東的資金來自營運（"FFO"）加上假設轉換後的金額為 486,826,000 美元，即每股稀釋後普通股 2.42 美元，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度歸屬於普通股股東的資金來自營運（"FFO"）加上假設轉換後的金額 470,021,000 美元，即每股稀釋後普通股 2.37 美元相比。2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度包含若干影響 FFO 的項目，如下表所列。這些項目的總計（扣除非控制性權益所屬部分）使 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度 FFO 增加 21,272,000 美元，即每股稀釋後普通股 0.10 美元，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度 FFO 增加 22,950,000 美元，即每股稀釋後普通股 0.11 美元相比。

headings: 我們可能因辦公室實體地產的趨勢而受到不利影響。
我們的實體地產有相當大一部分位於紐約都會區，且受此地區經濟週期及內在風險的影響。
我們面臨影響一般及紐約市零售環境的風險。
我們的營運表現及投資人對我們的投資價值，受我們實體地產資產及實體地產業的相關風險影響。
實體地產業是一項競爭性業務，而競爭可能對我們造成不利影響。
我們可能無法在租約到期時以有利條件續約、出租空置空間或重新出租空間。
租戶的破產或財務困難可能減少我們的營業收入、淨收入及現金流入。
我們的部分潛在損失可能無法由保險賠償覆蓋。
實際或威脅性的恐怖攻擊或其他犯罪行為可能不利於我們的資產價值及產生現金流的能力。
氣候變遷的影響可能對我們營運的地區產生集中性影響，並可能不利於我們的營運結果。
我們的資產面臨與氣候相關政策變動有關的過渡風險。
稅法的變更可能對REITs整體產生影響，並可能影響我們股票的交易及營運結果，其影響方式可能為正面或負面，且難以預測。
顯著的通貨膨脹及通貨膨脹率的上升可能不利於我們的業務及財務結果。
我們面臨與資產取得相關的風險。
我們面臨與資產開發、重建及重新定位相關的風險，這些風險可能對我們產生不利影響，包括財務狀況及營運結果。
可能難以及時出售不動產，這可能限制我們的靈活性。
本公司參與透過合資企業進行不動產活動所涉及之風險。
本公司所擁有之不動產涉及地面租賃安排，可能對本公司營運成果產生不利影響。
資本市場與經濟環境可能對本公司之流動性、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大影響，同時也可能影響投資人對本公司債券及股票之投資價值。
本公司目前有未償還債務，債務金額及其成本可能增加；再融資可能無法在可接受之條款下進行，可能影響本公司未來營運。
本公司可能無法取得資金以進行投資。
本公司可能使用避險工具以管理利率波動風險，但此等避險工具涉及風險。
本公司債務契約中之約束條款可能對本公司財務狀況及收購與開發活動產生不利影響。
本公司信用評級遭降級可能對本公司業務及財務狀況產生重大且不利影響。
Vornado 的修正並重述的信託聲明（"信託聲明"）設定了其股份持有權的限制。
馬裏蘭州公司法（"公司法"）包含了一些條款，可能降低某些收購交易的可能性。
Vornado 可能發行額外股份，這可能會不利於某些收購交易的可能性。
我們可能在不取得股東批准的情況下改變我們的政策。
Steven Roth 與 Interstate Properties 可能對我們有重大影響。他們與 Vornado 其他 trustees 和 officers 有些在其他實體中的權益或職位，這些可能與我們產生競爭。
Alexander's 與我們之間可能存在利益衝突。
Vornado 的普通股交易價格波動很大，可能持續波動。
Vornado 有許多股份可供未來出售，這可能會壓低其股份的市場價格以及運營合夥企業單位的贖回價格。
失去本公司關鍵人員可能影響本公司營運，並對本公司普通股及營運合夥人A級單位價值產生負面影響。
Vornado 可能無法符合或持續符合REIT資格，並可能被要求按公司稅率繳納聯邦所得稅，這可能會對本公司普通股價值產生負面影響。
paragraphs: 可能對我們業務、營運及財務狀況產生重大不利影響的因素如下所述。我們將 Vornado 及運營合夥企業的股權與債務證券均稱為 "securities"，並將擁有 Vornado 股票或運營合夥企業單位，或兩者皆有的投資人稱為 "equity holders"。 herein 所述的風險與不確定性可能並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要，也可能對我們的業務、營運及財務狀況產生不利影響。請參閱 herein 所含的 "Forward-Looking Statements"，位於第 6 頁。
與我們業務及營運相關的風險

2025 年，約 78% 的我們淨營運收入 ("NOI" 為非 GAAP 指標) 來自我們的辦公室資產。近年來，遠端辦公、彈性或混合工作排班、開放式辦公空間、視訊會議及電話會議已變得更加普遍。租戶空間使用率的變化，包括遠端辦公與彈性工作安排政策的持續，可能繼續導致辦公室租戶重新評估其長期的實體空間需求，這可能會對我們的業務產生不利影響。此外，人工智慧 ("AI") 的使用增加，可能會導致租戶空間使用率的變化，包括減少或重新配置空間的需求。
進一步而言，隨著辦公室租戶重新評估其實體空間需求並專注於吸引與留住人才，許多租戶變得更加挑剔，並專注於租賃位於高品質、現代化且設施完善的建築物，且靠近交通樞紐的空間。這些因素導致地主之間的競爭增加，以吸引租戶，地主對建築物進行大量資本支出以維持 Class A 等級，並可能對較舊且較不具吸引力的辦公空間價值產生負面影響。這可能會對我們的財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響。
2025 年，約 88% 的我們 NOI 來自位於紐約都會區的資產。我們可能繼續將未來的資產取得、開發及重建活動集中於此地區。房地產業市場受經濟衰退影響，我們無法預測經濟條件將如何影響此市場在短期或長期內。經濟衰退及紐約都會區房地產業市場的衰退已影響並可能繼續影響我們的財務表現及資產價值。除了影響國家總體經濟條件的一般因素外，影響此地區經濟條件的因素包括：
• 媒體、廣告、專業服務、金融、科技、零售、保險及房地產業的財務表現與生產力
